name: Ciruela Prisner
source:
Initially one of the holy knights and commander of the sixth holy knights corps. After the loss of her unit, she is reassigned to the seventh holy knight corps. Her weapon is a naginata.
[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Castle_Fantasia_2:_Seima_Taisen]Wikipedia[/url]]
